title: Switchboard error
description: Machine-readable lessons. Every error tells the agent what happened (code), what its human can do about it (human_action), when to retry (retry_after), and where to read more (docs_url). No free-form error prose is needed to act correctly.

human_action.description: What the human (not the agent) must do to unblock this, if anything.

retry_after.description: Seconds after which a retry may succeed.

suggestions.description: Up to three open taxonomy categories closest to the one that was refused, nearest first. Present on CATEGORY_PROHIBITED when the server can work them out; a server that cannot still refuses the listing the same way, so an agent must handle the field being absent.

candidates.description: Present on LOCATION_AMBIGUOUS: the places the name could have meant, largest first, at most five. 'display' is the fully qualified name to put to a human ('Perth, Scotland, GB'); 'place' is the exact string to send back in the listing's geo.place to choose that one. A server that cannot list them still refuses the listing the same way, so an agent must handle the field being absent.
